title: English from Absolute Zero
goal: Take a learner with zero English to full alphabetic literacy: recognising, naming, writing and sounding out all 26 letters, and reading and spelling their first words and sentences.

modules.title: Understanding English
modules.description: What English is, what a language is, how spoken and written English differ, and how the building blocks from letters to sentences fit together.

lessons.title: What Is a Language? What Is English?
objectives: Explain in simple words what a language is
Recognise English words in everyday pictures and sounds
lessons.assessment: Identify 8 of 10 English words from pictures and audio

lessons.title: Spoken versus Written English
objectives: Tell spoken English from written English apart
Match short spoken phrases to their written form
lessons.assessment: Match 5 of 6 spoken phrases to written phrases

checkpoint.criteria: Distinguish spoken from written English samples and identify English among other languages

lessons.title: Letters, Sounds, Words, Phrases and Sentences
objectives: Order the building blocks from letter to sentence
Hear the difference between a word and a phrase
lessons.assessment: Order the five building blocks correctly and classify 8 of 10 examples

lessons.title: How English Communication Works
objectives: Understand communication as message sent and received
Respond to simple greetings and instructions
lessons.assessment: Respond appropriately to 4 of 5 simple prompts

lessons.title: Introduction to Reading and Writing
objectives: Say what reading and writing are for
Trace and copy first letters and words
lessons.assessment: Trace or copy 5 letters and read 3 first words aloud

checkpoint.criteria: Order building blocks letter to sentence and complete a first read-and-copy task

modules.title: English Alphabet
modules.description: All 26 letters: names, recognition, uppercase and lowercase forms, handwriting, vowels versus consonants, sequencing, missing letters and capitalisation basics.

lessons.title: The Alphabet A-Z: Letter Names and Sequence
objectives: Say the 26 letter names in order
Recognise letters heard aloud
lessons.assessment: Name all 26 letters in order; recognise 10 of 10 letters by name

lessons.title: Uppercase Letters (Capitals)
objectives: Recognise all uppercase letters
Write uppercase letters from memory or by copying
lessons.assessment: Identify and write 26 of 26 uppercase letters

lessons.title: Lowercase Letters
objectives: Recognise all lowercase letters
Write lowercase letters from memory or by copying
lessons.assessment: Identify and write 26 of 26 lowercase letters

lessons.title: Matching Uppercase and Lowercase
objectives: Match every uppercase letter to its lowercase partner
Read words with mixed case
lessons.assessment: Match 26 of 26 upper/lowercase pairs; read 5 mixed-case words

checkpoint.criteria: Name, recognise and match all 26 letters in both cases

lessons.title: Vowels: A, E, I, O, U
objectives: Name the five (sometimes six) vowel letters
Pick vowels out of any word
lessons.assessment: Identify vowels in 8 of 10 words

lessons.title: Consonants
objectives: Recognise the 20 consonant letters
Separate vowels from consonants in words
lessons.assessment: Classify 20 of 20 letters as vowel or consonant

checkpoint.criteria: Classify all 26 letters as vowels or consonants

lessons.title: Alphabet Sequencing
objectives: Say which letter comes before or after another
Order shuffled letters correctly
lessons.assessment: Answer 8 of 10 before/after questions correctly

lessons.title: Identifying Missing Letters
objectives: Find the missing letter in a sequence
Spell simple letter sequences from memory
lessons.assessment: Fill 8 of 10 missing letters correctly

lessons.title: Capitalisation Basics
objectives: Use a capital letter for I, names and sentence starts
Spot wrongly lowercase or uppercase text
lessons.assessment: Correct 8 of 10 capitalisation errors

checkpoint.criteria: Sequence the alphabet, find missing letters and apply capitalisation basics

lessons.title: Letter Writing Practice
objectives: Form all 26 letters by hand or keyboard with correct shape
Write the alphabet from memory in under two minutes
lessons.assessment: Write all 26 letters legibly from dictation

lessons.title: Alphabet Review and Exercises
objectives: Consolidate the whole alphabet: names, forms, order, case
Self-check readiness for phonics
lessons.assessment: Score at least 90 percent on the mixed alphabet review

checkpoint.criteria: Pass the mixed alphabet review: names, cases, order, vowels and capitals

modules.title: Phonics and Sounds
modules.description: Letter names versus letter sounds, short and long vowels, consonants, blends, digraphs, letter combinations and the honest truth about sound-spelling patterns and their exceptions.

lessons.title: Letter Names versus Letter Sounds
objectives: Tell a letter's name from its sound
Produce the common sound of each letter
lessons.assessment: Give the correct sound for 20 of 26 letters

lessons.title: Basic Sound Awareness
objectives: Hear beginning and ending sounds of words
Recognise rhyming words
lessons.assessment: Identify beginning sounds of 8 of 10 words and 4 of 5 rhymes

checkpoint.criteria: Distinguish letter names from sounds and isolate beginning, ending and rhyming sounds

lessons.title: Short Vowel Sounds
objectives: Hear and say the five short vowel sounds
Connect short vowels to example words like cat and bed
lessons.assessment: Sort 10 of 12 words by their short vowel sound

lessons.title: Long Vowel Sounds
objectives: Hear and say the five long vowel sounds
Contrast short and long vowel pairs like cat and cake
lessons.assessment: Distinguish short from long vowels in 10 of 12 items

checkpoint.criteria: Discriminate and produce all short and long vowel sounds

lessons.title: Common Consonant Sounds
objectives: Produce the common sound of each consonant
Match consonant sounds to letters and words
lessons.assessment: Match consonant sounds to letters in 18 of 20 items

lessons.title: Consonant Blends
objectives: Blend two or three consonants together like bl, cr and st
Hear blends at the start and end of words
lessons.assessment: Identify and pronounce 8 of 10 common blends

lessons.title: Digraphs: ch, sh, th, ph, wh
objectives: Say the single sound of each digraph
Recognise digraphs inside simple words
lessons.assessment: Identify digraph sounds in 8 of 10 words

checkpoint.criteria: Produce consonant sounds, blends and digraphs in isolation and in words

lessons.title: Common Letter Combinations
objectives: Recognise frequent pairs like ee, oo, ai and oa
Read simple words containing these combinations
lessons.assessment: Read 8 of 10 words with common letter combinations

lessons.title: Sound Recognition Practice
objectives: Identify sounds in the beginning, middle and end of words
Match identical sounds across different words
lessons.assessment: Locate target sounds in 8 of 10 words

lessons.title: Pronunciation Basics
objectives: Pronounce practised sounds clearly
Slow down and self-correct when a sound is unclear
lessons.assessment: Repeat 10 target words recognisably in speech-recognition practice

lessons.title: Sound and Spelling Relationships: Patterns and Exceptions
objectives: Use reliable patterns such as short vowels in CVC words
Accept and expect exceptions: same sound spelled differently, silent letters, words like said and one
lessons.assessment: Sort 12 words into pattern-following and exception groups with at least 10 correct

checkpoint.criteria: Apply common sound-spelling patterns and state clearly that English spelling has exceptions

modules.title: First Reading Skills
modules.description: Blending letters into words, first CVC reading, word patterns, sight words, phrases, simple sentences and the first spelling exercises.

lessons.title: Combining Letters: Blending
objectives: Blend two and three sounds into words
Read nonsense practice syllables to master the mechanic
lessons.assessment: Blend 8 of 10 two- and three-sound items into words

lessons.title: Reading Simple Words (CVC)
objectives: Read consonant-vowel-consonant words like cat, bed and sit
Match read words to pictures
lessons.assessment: Read 12 of 15 CVC words correctly

lessons.title: Recognising Common Word Patterns
objectives: Read word families like -at, -an and -ig
Generate new family members by changing the first letter
lessons.assessment: Build and read 8 of 10 word-family members

checkpoint.criteria: Blend sounds and read CVC words and simple word families

lessons.title: Reading Short Phrases
objectives: Read two- and three-word phrases smoothly
Match phrases to pictures
lessons.assessment: Read 8 of 10 short phrases aloud correctly

lessons.title: Basic Sight Vocabulary
objectives: Recognise the 20 most frequent English words instantly
Read sight words inside simple sentences
lessons.assessment: Recognise 18 of 20 sight words on sight

lessons.title: Reading Simple Sentences
objectives: Read 3-6 word sentences with understanding
Show comprehension by choosing the matching picture
lessons.assessment: Read 6 of 8 simple sentences and match them to meanings

checkpoint.criteria: Read sight words, phrases and simple sentences with understanding

lessons.title: Initial Spelling Exercises
objectives: Spell practised CVC words from sounds
Apply beginning capitalisation and end punctuation
lessons.assessment: Spell 8 of 10 dictated words correctly

checkpoint.criteria: Spell practised CVC words from dictation with basic punctuation

exitAssessment.title: Foundations Exit Test
exitAssessment.criteria: Alphabet names, cases and order; vowel and consonant sounds including blends and digraphs; read 15 CVC and pattern words; recognise 20 sight words; read 5 simple sentences; spell 10 dictated words. The test explicitly includes irregular items so learners meet exceptions honestly.
